name: UI navigation, empty-state, and responsive polish audit

workspaceNavigation.findings: Sidebar filters and highlights active module correctly. AppShell grid layout maintains stable routes.

emptyMissingState.findings: All missing states return 'Chưa đủ dữ liệu' or 'needs_review'. Missing values are not falsified as zero. VCB is explicitly handled.

loadingErrorState.findings: No raw stack traces. loadFinancialsRuntimeData intercepts DB errors and returns unavailableResult gracefully.

responsiveMobile.findings: MainContent has pb-28 on mobile to clear MobileNavigation. RightAssistantPanel floats optimally using bottom-20.

dataQualityBadge.findings: Next.js SSR correctly encodes 'Chưa phê duyệt sản xuất'. UI components strictly enforce research_only badges.

aiAssistantPanel.findings: Panel warns explicitly: 'AI không đưa lời khuyên mua, bán hoặc nắm giữ'. No unsafe investment advice leaks.
